title: Halogen-Free Flame Retardant Polypropylene Fibers with Modified Intumescent Flame Retardant: Preparation, Characterization, Properties and Mode of Action
authors: Qibin Xu; Lei Wu; Xiang Yan; Shengchang Zhang; Linan Dong; Zexi Su; Tianhaoyue Zhong; Chunhui Jiang; Yuan Chen; Mengjin Jiang; Pengqing Liu
source_version: Published original sixteen-page article and official four-page supporting information
sample_state: mPP; initial melt-spun and post-treated fiber control; 95 wt% PP and 5 wt% MA-g-PP feed
composition: Table 1: 95 wt% polypropylene T30S and 5 wt% maleic-anhydride-grafted polypropylene E43; no Dohor-6000A flame retardant. Prose designation pure polypropylene retained as source wording.
washing_state: Initial manufactured fiber state; no durability wash reported
treatment_chemistry: No Dohor-6000A added; 5 wt% MA-g-PP compatibilizer in source control formulation
treatment_method: Polypropylene T30S, MFI 2.6 g/10 min, from Lanzhou Petrochemical; E43 maleic-anhydride-grafted polypropylene from Westlake Chemical. Table 1 mPP feed 95/0/5 wt% PP/modified Dohor-6000A/MA-g-PP was blended in a twin-screw extruder and granulated. Chips were melt spun using a Beijing Paigu Precision Machinery machine: single-screw extruder with five heating zones, volumetric pump and 18-orifice spinneret; as-spun take-up speed 200 m/min. Post-drawing and heat-setting followed, with methods stretching ratio 4, stretching temperature 130 °C and heat-setting time 300 s. Table 4 instead lists draw ratio 3.4 for mPP and all treated fibers; the contradiction is unresolved. Extrusion zone temperatures, spin finish, heat-setting temperature as distinct from stretching temperature, and conditioning are unreported.
source_draw_ratio_raw: Section 2.4: stretching ratio 4; Table 4: draw ratio 3.4, unresolved
source_control_wording_raw: Table 1 mPP is 95% PP and 5% MA-g-PP; main prose calls control pure polypropylene fiber
TGA_specimen_preparation: Own mPP fibers, Q500 thermal analysis from 30 to 700 °C at 10 °C/min in air. Cutting/grinding, pan, sample mass, air flow, preconditioning and replicate count unreported; MCC powder preparation and approximately 5 mg are not transferred.
source_material_form_TGA_raw: Section 3.3.3 and Figure 10 refer to TG/DTG of the fibers; Table S3 expressly lists mPP in a series of fibers under air atmosphere.
LOI_method: Measured with JF-3 oxygen index instrument, Jiangning District Analytical Instrument Co., according to ISO 4589-2; edition unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: Fibers braided into 6 × 3 × 70 mm bundles; LOI specimen conditioning, ignition details and replication unreported.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Table S3 p 4 gives exact mPP R500/R600/R700, with R700 repeated in section 3.3.3. Section 3.3.1 gives exact own measured control LOI 18. No plotted coordinates are digitized.
source_T0_definition: Temperature of 5 wt% weight loss, Table S3 footnote a
source_T0_increase_conflict_raw: Section 3.3.3 says 25% IFR increases T0 by 32.3 °C; Table S3 mPP 239.4 and mPP-IFR-25 271.9 °C do not yield that difference. Both raw source entries retained; canonical T5 blank.
conditions_locator: Sections 2.1–2.5 pp 3–4, Tables 1 and 4 pp 3/9; SI Table S3 p 4
TG_locator: SI Table S3 p 4; main section 3.3.3 and Figure 10 p 12

source_location: Complete original sixteen-page published article, own methods and results, Tables 1–5, Figures 1–11, conclusion and references; complete official four-page SI. Main pp 3, 4, 9, 10, 12 and SI p 4 checked as pixels.
limitations: The control is the source mPP fiber, whose Table 1 feed formulation is 95 wt% polypropylene and 5 wt% maleic-anhydride-grafted polypropylene; the prose calls this pure polypropylene. Its formulation is retained as stated in Table 1, without treating it as a separately measured 100% PP state. The methods give a stretching ratio of 4, while Table 4 lists a draw ratio of 3.4 for every fiber, including mPP. Both source statements are retained and no exact resolved draw ratio is assigned. The LOI method braids fibers into 6 × 3 × 70 mm bundles; TG assays the same named prepared fiber formulation, but its cutting, grinding, pan, sample mass, gas flow, conditioning and replication are unreported. Grinding and approximately 5 mg samples refer to the subsequent MCC method and are not transferred to TG. Q600 nitrogen TG-FTIR is a separate assay; the tabulated TG data use Q500 under air. Residues at 500, 600 and 700 °C are explicit Table S3 values, with R700 0.07% repeated in main prose; no visual zero is substituted. Table S3 gives mPP T0 239.4 °C and defines T0 as 5 wt% loss, but the reported increase for the 25% formulation is 32.3 °C in main prose while the two Table S3 values imply a different difference. The unresolved relation is retained without correcting either source value; canonical T5 is blank. The source Tmax 349.9 °C and undefined Td 364.8 °C are retained in native fields, with no assigned canonical peak or threshold. The 25% formulation has conflicting LOI 28% in section 3.3.1 and 29.1% in the abstract/conclusion; it is excluded. The other treated LOIs in Figure 7 are unlabelled plotted points and are not estimated. Figure 10 labels the red TG curve mPP-IFR-15, whereas Table S3 labels its corresponding first treated row mPP-IFR-10; those treated states remain excluded. No durability wash is reported. PDF text extraction contains duplicated passages and review-header strings; sampled visible pages carry the published article identity. Published identity and numerical pixels were checked against the original publisher HTML and official SI.
pairing_evidence: The same mPP fiber series is defined by Table 1 and the melt-spinning/post-treatment methods. Section 3.3.1 gives control LOI 18 from the own instrument method on braided fiber bundles. Section 3.3.3/Figure 10 and SI Table S3 independently label mPP fiber TG under air, including explicit R500 0.99/R600 0.36/R700 0.07. No chip/bulk-polymer TG, MCC temperature or postwash result is paired.
